# Field rows: five dark soil ridges 3.2 m long (triangular prisms 0.45 wide, 0.22 tall) with a row of
# chunky crop tufts on each. Up Z.
new
material new Soil --base-color 0.200 0.173 0.314 --no-slot
material new Crop --base-color 0.580 0.890 0.267 --no-slot
add mesh cylinder --name Row0 --vertices 3 --radius 0.26 --depth 3.2 --location 0 0 0 --rotation 0 -90 0
apply --rotation
scale 1 1 0.85
apply --scale
material assign Soil
duplicate
translate 0 0.75 0
duplicate
translate 0 0.75 0
duplicate
translate 0 0.75 0
duplicate
translate 0 0.75 0
add mesh ico-sphere --name Tuft0 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.17 --location -1.3 0 0.25
material assign Crop
duplicate
translate 0.65 0 0
duplicate
translate 0.65 0 0
duplicate
translate 0.65 0 0
duplicate
translate 0.65 0 0
select Tuft0 Tuft0.001 Tuft0.002 Tuft0.003 Tuft0.004
active Tuft0
join
duplicate
translate 0.33 0.75 0
duplicate
translate -0.33 0.75 0
duplicate
translate 0.33 0.75 0
duplicate
translate -0.33 0.75 0
select all
translate 0 -1.5 0
shade flat
export field.glb
